item.stem:
The diagram shows Qasim's circuit: a cell, a lamp, and a gap. A metal strip (a conductor) closes the gap so a current path can form.

Will the lamp glow?

options.A: Yes — the metal strip is a conductor, so it completes the current path and the lamp can glow.
options.B: No — a metal strip across the gap blocks the current path, so the lamp stays dark.
options.C: Yes — the lamp glows even if the gap is left open, because the cell is still in the circuit.
options.D: No — the lamp glows only if two metal strips are placed in the gap.
